ByteDance is a technology company seeking a graduate Backend Development Engineer to join its Infrastructure Delivery Platform Team. The role focuses on building global infrastructure digital platforms and backend systems for procurement, delivery, planning, asset management, data center operations, and cost management, while handling full-cycle development and production issues.

Execute full cycle development, including requirement analysis, solution design, technical feasibility studies, code implementation, and unit testing
